svg.title: From network manager configuration to peerings
svg.desc: avnm-… holds the network group ng-spokes, with the two spokes as static members, and two configurations on it, cc-hub-spoke and sac-lab. Nothing applies until the Connectivity and SecurityAdmin deployments commit them; then each spoke gets an ANM_ peering to vnet-hub, and the spokes reach each other as a connected group with no peering between them.
